camera_title: A photo helps people recognise the animal
camera_body: We only use the camera when you take a photo of the animal. You can also choose a photo from your gallery.
camera_denied: Camera access is off. Choose a photo from your gallery or add one later.
location_body: We use your location to mark the place faster. We only show an approximate area in public.
location_denied: Location access is off. Search for the place or mark it on the map.
notifications_title: Shall we tell you when something happens?
notifications_body: We let you know about possible matches, new messages and lost animals nearby. You choose what you get in settings.
notifications_denied: Phone notifications are off. You will find everything in your inbox and email.
